## [0.2.0] - 2026-10-11

### Added

- Added opt-in local spaCy enrichment and stderr progress to speech workflows
- Added in-memory SSMD analysis, projection, freeze, and context APIs with explicit disk caching

### Changed

- Changed language resolution to preserve inline SSMD scopes over base-language overrides
- Changed EPUB book conversion to freeze safe automatic speech decisions by default
- **BREAKING:** Changed Python conversion to use immutable options and typed results

### Documentation

- Documented the v0.2 Python API migration and deferred 1.0.0 stability target

## [0.1.0] - 2026-10-01

### Added

- Added EPUB chapter inspection, source-number selection, and standalone SSMD chapter conversion
- Added editable directory and portable ZIP bundles with manifest-defined chapter order
- Added case-insensitive .ssmd.md detection as an SSMD input suffix

### Changed

- Changed EPUB chapter extraction to use epub2text while preserving combined conversion results
- Added dedicated book inspect, convert, and validate CLI subcommands with JSON inspection and validation output
- Made book bundle formats explicit and writes atomic, deterministic, and non-overwriting unless requested
- Recorded source hashes at book conversion and separated original navigation parents from canonical chapter parents
- Moved speech preparation dependencies into the optional speech extra
